23563-viewpoint.title: Viewpoint
23563-viewpoint.creator: Unknown
23563-viewpoint.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He tried to force his memory to give him the information he was looking for, but it wouldn't come. A face flickered in his mind for a moment, and a name. He seemed to remember a startled look on the Italian's face, but he could neither remember the reason for it nor when it had been. But it would come back; he was sure of that.

79536-the-story-of-the-world-a-thousand-.title: Next Thousand Years
79536-the-story-of-the-world-a-thousand-.creator: Unknown
79536-the-story-of-the-world-a-thousand-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. IN this unique “Story of the World a Thousand Years Hence,” I shall endeavor to show by simple words and attractive illustrations how our much advanced posterity a thousand years hence will likely think, live, work, play, educate, court, dress, mate, cook, eat, drink, co-operate, raise and train children, build, pave, farm, manufacture, communicate, travel, invent, and do many other things too numerous to mention in a brief forecast of a thousand years.

arxiv-1904-09321.title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network and Sparse Least Squares Migration
arxiv-1904-09321.creator: Zhaolun Liu, Yuqing Chen and Gerard Schuster
arxiv-1904-09321.description: Abstract We recast the forward pass of a multilayered convolutional neural network (CNN) as the solution to the problem of sparse least squares migration (LSM). The CNN filters and feature maps are shown to be analogous, but not equivalent, to the migration Green’s functions and the quasi-reflectivity distribution, respectively.

arxiv-2105-02346.title: Estimating the Impact of BGP Prefix Hijacking Thanks: This research is co-financed by Greece and European Union through the Operational Program Competitiveness, Entrepreneurship and Innovation under the call RESEARCH-CREATE-INNOVATE (project T2EDK-04937), and the European High-Performance Computing
arxiv-2105-02346.creator: Pavlos Sermpezis, Vasileios Kotronis, Konstantinos Arakadakis, Athena Vakali
arxiv-2105-02346.description: Abstract BGP prefix hijacking is a critical threat to the resilience and security of communications in the Internet. While several mechanisms have been proposed to prevent, detect or mitigate hijacking events, it has not been studied how to accurately quantify the impact of an ongoing hijack.

arxiv-2108-12221.title: Experimental Determination of the Interaction Potential between a Helium Atom and the Interior Surface of a C 60 \mathrm{C_{60}} Fullerene Molecule
arxiv-2108-12221.creator: George Razvan Bacanu, Tanzeeha Jafari, Mohamed Aouane, Jyrki Rantaharju, Mark Walkey, Gabriela Hoffman, Anna Shugai, Urmas Nagel, Monica Jiménez-Ruiz, Anthony J. Horsewill, Stéphane Rols, Toomas Rõõm, Richard J. Whitby, Malcolm H. Levitt
arxiv-2108-12221.description: Abstract The interactions between atoms and molecules may be described by a potential energy function of the nuclear coordinates. Non-bonded interactions are dominated by repulsive forces at short range and attractive dispersion forces at long range. Experimental data on the detailed interaction potentials for non-bonded interatomic and intermolecular forces is scarce.

arxiv-2206-03011.title: An extension to the applicability of adaptive bandwidth choice
arxiv-2206-03011.creator: Dehao Dai
arxiv-2206-03011.description: Abstract In this paper, we extend the applicability of the bandwidth choice method of Politis 2003 by relaxing the conditions of his Theorem 2.3. 1 Introduction Assume X_{1},\cdots,X_{N} are data from the strictly stationary time series \{X_{n},n\in\mathbb{Z}\} with mean \mu=\mathbb{E}X_{t} , and autocovariance \gamma(k)=\mathbb{E}\left(X_{t}-\mu\right)\left(X_{t+|k|}-\right. \mu) ; here both \mu and \gamma(\cdot) are unknown.

arxiv-2207-01544.title: A note on improved differentiability for the Banach-space valued Finsler γ \gamma -Laplacian
arxiv-2207-01544.creator: Max Goering and Lukas Koch
arxiv-2207-01544.description: Abstract We obtain improved fractional differentiability of solutions to the Banach-space valued Finsler γ \gamma -Laplacian defined on a σ \sigma -convex, τ \tau -smooth Banach space. The operators we consider are non-linear and very degenerately elliptic. Our results are new already in the ℝ \mathbb{R} -valued setting.

arxiv-2301-11331.title: Exact quantum ground state of a two-dimensional quasicrystalline antiferromagnet
arxiv-2301-11331.creator: Pratyay Ghosh
arxiv-2301-11331.description: Abstract We present the exact dimer ground state of a quantum antiferromagnet defined on a quasicrystal constructed from the Bronze-mean hexagonal quasicrystal. A coupling isotropy on the first and second-neighbor bonds is sufficient to stabilize a product state of singlets on the third-neighbor bonds.

arxiv-2302-00114.title: Real-time quantitative imaging of RTV silicone pyrolysis
arxiv-2302-00114.creator: Collin W. Foster, Sreevishnu Oruganti, Francesco Panerai
arxiv-2302-00114.description: Abstract Quantitative microstructural analysis of Room Temperature Vulcanized (RTV) silicone pyrolysis at high temperatures is presented. RTV is used as a bonding agent in multiple industries, particularly filling gaps in ablative tiles for hypersonic (re-)entry vehicles and fire prevention. Decomposition of RTV is resolved in real time using in situ high-temperature X-ray computed micro-tomography.

arxiv-2403-09263.title: A noncommutative maximal inequality for Fejér means on totally disconnected non-Abelian groups
arxiv-2403-09263.creator: Fugui Ding, Guixiang Hong, Xumin Wang
arxiv-2403-09263.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fugui Ding, Guixiang Hong, Xumin Wang. In this paper, we explore Fourier analysis for noncommutative L p L_{p} space-valued functions on G G , where G G is a totally disconnected non-abelian compact group. By additionally assuming that the value of these functions remains invariant within each conjugacy class, we establish a noncommutative maximal inequality for Fejér means utilizing the associated character system of G G . This is an operator-valued version of the classical result due to Gát in [ Gát06 ] .

arxiv-2407-15752.title: Broad and Spectral-Efficient Beamforming for the Uni-polarized Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2407-15752.creator: Mohammad Javad-Kalbasi, Student Member, IEEE, Mohammed Saif, Member, IEEE, Shahrokh Valaee, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2407-15752.description: Abstract A reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) is composed of low-cost elements that manipulate the propagation environment from a transmitter by intelligently applying phase shifts to incoming signals before they are reflected. This paper explores a uni-polarized RIS with linear shape aimed at transmitting a common signal to multiple user equipments (UEs) spread across a wide angular region.

arxiv-2412-17918.title: Emulation of the final r -process abundance pattern with a neural network
arxiv-2412-17918.creator: Rebecca Surman
arxiv-2412-17918.description: Abstract This work explores the construction of a fast emulator for the calculation of the final pattern of nucleosynthesis in the rapid neutron capture process (the r r -process). An emulator is built using a feed-forward artificial neural network (ANN). We train the ANN with nuclear data and relative abundance patterns.

arxiv-2501-11078.title: On the Topological Features of the Helical Phase Transition in MnSi.
arxiv-2501-11078.creator: S. M. Stishov, A. E. Petrova, A. M. Belemuk
arxiv-2501-11078.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. M. Stishov, A. E. Petrova, A. M. Belemuk. Many decades of study have revealed very unusual properties of the helical phase transition in MnSi. This situation is briefly described and illustrated in the present note. As one will be able to see, one peculiarity is that the phase transition point in MnSi is accompanied by extremes of different thermodynamic and kinetic quantities on the high temperature side of the transition, which look similar to a property of 2D systems.

arxiv-2503-01363.title: FABG : End-to-end Imitation Learning for Embodied Affective Human-Robot Interaction
arxiv-2503-01363.creator: Yanghai Zhang, Changyi Liu, Keting Fu, Wenbin Zhou, Qingdu Li, Jianwei Zhang
arxiv-2503-01363.description: Abstract This paper proposes FABG (Facial Affective Behavior Generation), an end-to-end imitation learning system for human-robot interaction, designed to generate natural and fluid facial affective behaviors. In interaction, effectively obtaining high-quality demonstrations remains a challenge. In this work, we develop an immersive virtual reality (VR) demonstration system that allows operators to perceive stereoscopic environments.

arxiv-2507-01280.title: D-wave condensates and the landscape of the 2D Hubbard model
arxiv-2507-01280.creator: Kazue Matsuyama and Jeff Greensite
arxiv-2507-01280.description: Abstract We consider BCS-like states in the 2D Hubbard model which, starting from some arbitrary point in field space in the neighborhood of a Hartree-Fock ground state, are relaxed within that BCS ansatz to local minima of the energy. As in the Hartree-Fock approximation there are a vast number of local minima.

arxiv-2508-11743.title: Thermalization of Bottomonium in the Quark–Gluon Plasma Preprint: TUM-EFT 196/25
arxiv-2508-11743.creator: Nora Brambilla, Tom Magorsch, and Antonio Vairo
arxiv-2508-11743.description: Abstract We study the approach to equilibrium of bottomonium in the quark-gluon plasma within the open quantum system framework. We perform large-scale simulations of the long-time behavior in three dimensions using the quantum trajectory method to observe the emergence of steady states and determine the timescale of thermalization in position-, angular-momentum-, and color-space.

arxiv-2510-09341.title: Triadic percolation on multilayer networks
arxiv-2510-09341.creator: Hanlin Sun, Filippo Radicchi, Ginestra Bianconi
arxiv-2510-09341.description: Abstract Triadic interactions are special types of higher-order interactions that occur when regulator nodes modulate the interactions between other two or more nodes. In presence of triadic interactions, a percolation process occurring on a single-layer network becomes a fully-fledged dynamical system, characterized by period-doubling and a route to chaos.

arxiv-2512-24760.title: Runaway electron avalanche and macroscopic beam formation: simulations of the DTT full power scenario
arxiv-2512-24760.creator: Enrico Emanuelli, Francesco Vannini, Matthias Hoelzl, Eric Nardon, Vinodh Bandaru, Nina Schwarz, Daniele Bonfiglio, Giuseppe Ramogida, Fabio Subba, JOREK Team
arxiv-2512-24760.description: Abstract The transition of the Divertor Tokamak Test (DTT) facility from its initial commissioning phase (Day-0, plasma current I p = 2 I_{p}=2 MA) to the full power scenario ( I p = 5.5 I_{p}=5.5 MA) introduces a critical shift in the dynamics of runaway electrons (REs) generation.

arxiv-2601-22310.title: Moiré folded helical states at the interfaces of heterostructures
arxiv-2601-22310.creator: Paula Mellado
arxiv-2601-22310.description: Abstract A minimal model of a graphene–topological-insulator heterostructure is considered, where a moiré superlattice modulates the Rashba spin–orbit interaction (SOC). In the spin-degenerate, spin–orbit-free limit, the reduced Brillouin zone contains flat, spin-degenerate moiré minibands, with periodicity determined by superlattice folding. The inclusion of SOC lifts the spin degeneracy and reduces the effective spectral periodicity by a factor of two.

pmc-10505300.title: Targeting PTBP1 blocks glutamine metabolism to improve the cisplatin sensitivity of hepatocarcinoma cells through modulating the mRNA stability of glutaminase
pmc-10505300.creator: Ruimin Tian, Yanfei Li, Xiaojie Shen, Ying Li
pmc-10505300.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a frequently diagnosed malignancy with a high mortality rate. Cisplatin (CDDP) is a widely applied anti-cancer drug. However, a large population of liver cancer patients developed CDDP resistance. The polypyrimidine tract binding protein (PTBP1) is an RNA-binding protein involving in progressions of diverse cancers.

pmc-10590962.title: An experimental design for obtaining DNA of a target species and its diet from a single non‐invasive genetic protocol
pmc-10590962.creator: Shrutarshi Paul, Naama Shahar, Merav Seifan, Shirli Bar‐David
pmc-10590962.description: Next‐generation sequencing technology has enabled accurate insights into the diet of wildlife species. The protocols for faecal sample collection and DNA extraction for diet analysis have differed from those focusing on target species, even in most studies combining questions on both aspects.

pmc-10658260.title: Exploring safety capacity from a risk and safety information integration perspective: Connotation, dimension mining and dimensionality reduction
pmc-10658260.creator: Fang Yan, Xuan Li, Bing Wang, Youxian Xie, Chao Wu
pmc-10658260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). With the development of safety science, the concept of safety capacity (SC) has been proposed. SC has been applied in many fields. Concurrently, there has been an active and robust development of research pertaining to it. However, SC research mainly focuses on practical engineering problems, and SC research is only regarded as the establishment of a quantitative model for system safety. Hence, the theoretical study of SC is ignored. Indeed, the integrated theoretical system and connotation of SC are lacking.

pmc-12391316.title: RAD18 methylation by the methyltransferase SETD6 attenuates DNA breaks
pmc-12391316.creator: Lital Estrella Weil, Michal Feldman, Jennifer Van Duine, Ji Qiu, Joshua LaBaer, Dan Levy
pmc-12391316.description: This study investigated the interaction between the SETD6 lysine methyltransferase and RAD18, a key protein in the DNA damage repair pathway. SETD6 belongs to the SET-domain-containing family of proteins, which are known to catalyze protein methylation, a post-translational modification that plays a critical role in regulating protein function, stability, and interactions.

pmc-12548420.title: Ebola virus’ hidden target: virus transmission to and infection of skin
pmc-12548420.creator: Paige T. Richards, Anthony M. Fleck, Radhika Patel, Maryam Fakhimi, Dana Bohan, Kathleen Geoghegan-Barek, Anna N. Honko, Allison E. Stolte, Caroline B. Plescia, Caitlin O. Messingham, Samuel J. Connell, Tyler P. Crowe, Francoise A. Gourronc, Ricardo Carrion, Anthony Griffiths, David K. Meyerholz, Al
pmc-12548420.description: Ebola virus (EBOV), the causative agent of Ebola virus disease, remains one of the World Health Organization’s top 10 threats to global health. Infectious EBOV virions can be found on the surface of skin late in infection and may be transmitted to others through skin-to-skin contact.

pmc-12583322.title: Guidelines and recommendations for radiographer education from the EU-REST project
pmc-12583322.creator: Jonathan P McNulty, Francis Zarb, the European Federation of Radiographer Societies, the European Society of Radiology
pmc-12583322.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AbstractAdvancements in medical imaging, nuclear medicine, and radiotherapy have significantly improved patient care, while also requiring responsive education and training programmes and continuing professional development (CPD) for radiographers who work across medical imaging, nuclear medicine, and radiotherapy. This article presents findings from the EU-REST (European Union Radiation, Education, Staffing and Training) project with a focus on the evaluation of education and training requirements for radiographers across EU Member States.

pmc-12669824.title: Prospective trial on focal treatment with hemigland brachytherapy in low-risk prostate cancer: A negative study
pmc-12669824.creator: Cristina Gutiérrez, Elena Villafranca, Montse Ferrer, Amaya Sola, Andrea Slocker, Montse Ventura, Ignacio Visus, Francisco Pino, Marta Barrado, Margarita Illas, Dina Najjari, Naiara Fuentemilla, Pablo Araguás, Santiago Pellejero, Olatz Garin
pmc-12669824.description: PurposeTo determine whether hemi-gland seed brachytherapy (HGBT) is as effective as whole-gland seed brachytherapy (WGBT) in patients with single-lobe, low-risk and favorable intermediate-risk prostate cancer (PCa).Material and methodsPhase II clinical trial in patients with low- and favorable intermediate-risk PCa with HGBT. Enrolment took place between 2016 and 2020. All patients (n = 38) underwent HGBT with iodine-125 (125I) seeds.

pmc-13107749.title: Dynamics of Mpox epidemics by the interplay of COVID-19 pandemic in Africa
pmc-13107749.creator: Oyewole K. Oyedele, Nifarta P. Andrew, Motunrayo D. Olalere, Monalisa O. Owie, Victoria Etuk, Temitayo Lawal, Olugbenga Akinbiyi, Evaezi Okpokoro, Alash’le Abimiku
pmc-13107749.description: BackgroundMpox epidemics continue to spread to African borders following the outbreak that has affected over 120 countries and thus posed a threat to global health security. Dynamics of Mpox spread over time, fatality, and country-level risk were investigated intra- and post-COVID-19 pandemic to inform optimal surveillance, response, and prevention strategy.

pmc-13313687.title: Direct contact between iPSC-derived macrophages and hepatocytes drives reciprocal acquisition of Kupffer cell identity and hepatocyte maturation
pmc-13313687.creator: Christopher Zhe Wei Lee, Farah Tasnim, Xiaozhong Huang, Raman Sethi, Yoohyun Song, Tatsuya Kozaki, Sebastiaan De Schepper, Nicholas Ang, Ivy Low, You Yi Hwang, Jinmiao Chen, Hanry Yu, Florent Ginhoux, Simon Yona, Christopher Zhe Wei Lee, Farah Tasnim, Xiaozhong Huang, Raman Sethi, Yoohyun Song, Tats
pmc-13313687.description: As the resident tissue macrophage of the liver, Kupffer cells (KCs) play an important role in homeostasis and tissue support. However, current in vitro liver models often ignore the contribution of these KCs towards the proper response and function of the tissue. This is especially relevant when we consider the implications of immune-mediated drug injuries.

pmc-13347956.title: Global prostate cancer risk associated with microplastic exposure: a statistical and machine learning analysis
pmc-13347956.creator: Ashraf M. T. Elewa, Moustafa Gamal Snousy, Fatimah M. Alghamdi, Gamal A. Abd-Elmougod, Alia A. El Shahawy, Amany Fahmi Mohamed, Abdelazim Negm, Ahmed M. Saqr, Hussein M. Elshafie
pmc-13347956.description: IntroductionProstate cancer is one of the most commonly diagnosed malignancies among men worldwide, with higher reported incidence in many high-income countries. Environmental factors are receiving increasing attention as potential contributors to cancer development. Microplastics, which are found in air, water, food, and personal care items, are one possible risk factor.

pmc-13492339.title: Editorial: thematic issue on microbial ecotoxicology of contaminants of emerging concern
pmc-13492339.creator: Sébastien Duperron, Stéphane Vuilleumier, Kristian K Brandt, Mechthild Schmitt-Jansen, Natàlia Corcoll

pmc-13506456.title: Toward a Culturally Situated SDT–EI Model of emotional intelligence in physical education: a narrative review
pmc-13506456.creator: Jiayin Lin, Huanling Ma
pmc-13506456.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Emotional intelligence (EI) has emerged as a pivotal construct in educational psychology; however, understanding of how physical education (PE) contributes to its development remains fragmented. Eight prior systematic reviews have concluded that PE can develop EI, but three gaps persist: no integration across educational stages, no unified mechanistic account, and no cross-cultural perspective—despite emerging evidence that EI pathways differ across cultural contexts.

pmc-13568386.title: Super-Resolution-Assisted Farmland Boundary Extraction from Medium-Resolution Satellite Image: A Real-ESRGAN and YOLO Segmentation Framework
pmc-13568386.creator: Junyao Yu, Hui Yin, Xiaofan Huang, Jiaying Liu, Shangguo Yang, Baisheng Zeng, Jiayu Zhang, Xuanyan Wang, Bo Xiong
pmc-13568386.description: Highlights What are the main findings? An extraction framework for fragmented farmland boundaries from medium-resolution imagery with strong generalization capability.A quantitative link between super-resolution reconstruction quality and downstream segmentation accuracy. What are the implications of the main findings? A freely available alternative to high-resolution satellite data for precision agriculture monitoring in data-scarce regions.
